title: Marketplace
subtitle: Posted-ask secondary listings for existing shareholders. VenturePath is a bulletin board — closings happen off-platform via lawyer and board consent. No escrow, no fund movement on platform.
empty.title: No listings yet.
empty.body: From the cap table, choose a shareholder row and click "List for sale" — or use the button above.
detail.rofr.heading: ROFR — Right of First Refusal
detail.rofr.no_holders: No other ordinary-share holders to notify.
detail.manage.heading: Manage listing
detail.manage.body: Once you've closed off-platform, mark this listing sold so the kill-criteria analytics reflect the outcome. If the deal fell through, withdraw the listing.
detail.how_closing_works.title: How closing works
detail.how_closing_works.body: VenturePath is a posted-ask bulletin board. Closing happens off-platform: buyer and seller engage lawyers, draft an SPA, capture board consent, and update the registry. VenturePath does not handle funds, custody, or settlement. Capital-gains tax treatment (ZATCA) is the seller's responsibility.
actions.mark_sold.cap_table_hint: Providing buyer details will automatically update your cap table.
actions.mark_sold.confirm_body: This will update your cap table and cannot be undone.
browse.title: Shareholders selling, companies for sale
browse.subtitle: Public secondary-share listings and whole-company exit listings across every VenturePath workspace. No fund movement on platform — closing happens off-platform.
